THE DRAGON AWAKES

Last night the sky's oldest dragon spat sparks across the dark, and the whole heaven once turned around it.

The Draconid meteors peaked under an almost moonless sky, and tomorrow the New Moon meets the Sun at 17° Libra.

Around 2800 BC its star Thuban sat almost exactly on the celestial pole, still the Pole Star when the Great Pyramid rose. The Greeks saw Ladon, the sleepless serpent guarding the golden apples. The Sefer Yetzirah names the Teli, the power at the axis of the world, "like a king on his throne," and later commentators pictured it as a dragon. תלי = 400 + 30 + 10 = 440.

October keeps its dates. On October 9, 1933, thousands of meteors an hour poured out of Draco over Europe. On October 9, 1946, it stormed again, and British radar teams tracked it.

The axis becomes a serpent. The serpent becomes a rain of light.

Did you catch one last night? 👇

As above, so below. ⛈️
